verdict.rationale: Parsec for Teams documents provisioning a Team Computer and assigning it to a team member or group, plus a Teams API for automating deployment. This implies pre-configured access to managed hosts, but the evidence never states that connections need no host-side approval. missing for 10: explicit documentation of unattended access with no accept prompt at the host, details of how credentials or permissions are pre-configured on the host, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended connections.
